reason: The plugin adds image understanding to DeepSeek conversations by translating attached images through configured VLM endpoints, with optional local Ollama support and image preprocessing.

summaries.zh: 将对话中的图片通过配置的视觉语言模型转换为文字，再交由 DeepSeek 生成回答。
summaries.en: Translates images attached to conversations through a configured vision-language model and passes the resulting text to DeepSeek for responses.

capabilities: Translates attached images into text using configured vision-language model endpoints
Routes translated image descriptions to DeepSeek for conversational responses
Supports configurable OpenAI-compatible remote endpoints and local Ollama
Reads configured API keys or environment variables for vision services
Caches image translation results in process memory and can resize large images before translation
